title: Translations
description: Spanish lines and words in the novel with this site's own English. Only the opening words (incipit) of each Spanish span are published, never the full span; the Campbell guide is linked by page, never copied. See docs/plan.md, sections 3 and 8.

page.description: Approximate Vintage International page, interpolated between Campbell guide anchors.

es_incipit.description: The span's opening words, at most five, with an ellipsis when cut. The full span is never published.

en.description: This site's own English translation; null while a draft is pending.

source.description: Who wrote the English. Only site translations are published until permission arrives (plan section 3).

location_ref.description: Id of the stop, place or area where it was said (stops, places or areas GeoJSON), or of the route segment (journeys GeoJSON) for talk on the road.

location_kind.description: Which layer location_ref is in; null when location_ref is null. 'road' is inferred by this site: the line has no place, and its episode is spent travelling that route segment. The map shows it as the segment buffered 2 km, 'on the road between X and Y'.

guide_page.description: The Vintage page under which the Campbell guide lists this line, for a link with credit; null when the guide has no entry (a gap).
